complete_description_policy.rules: Accept no empty description or narrative exceeding 12,000 characters. Preserve complete publisher text after shared HTML normalization; never apply a generic 2,000-character cap or substitute a listing/JSON-LD excerpt. Every accepted record carries its complete description SHA-256.
complete_description_policy.detail_hydration: Hydrate 136 BKUP, 55 Wave Hill, 12 Bronx River and 16 NYRR normal HTML detail pages before releasing their completed snapshots.
complete_description_policy.native_apis: Use complete native bodies from Fordham Localist, CB6 TEC, Brooklyn Bridge Park ACF, Transportation Alternatives Mobilize and the official NYC Parks municipal dataset.

remaining_source_holds.reason: Official robots allows several named search-engine agents but explicitly denies all paths to User-agent:*. The production collector user agent is denied. No calendar/detail fetch or user-agent spoof was attempted.

Old-host API paths are explicitly robots-denied. Public frontend search discovery does not justify bypassing the canonical access block. No private credentials or blocked canonical details were requested.
The official robots endpoint returned HTTP 202 twice, so the guarded transport could not establish publisher admission. No calendar/details were fetched and no workaround was used.

Advertised feed and Outlook export routes under /nx are also denied. No POST request was made; adding POST support would not resolve the robots block. The legacy Mikle widget 153255 returned HTTP 404.

The existing production baseline is robots_denied. No disallowed endpoint, bypass or unproven reactivation was attempted.
